subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
We have M0D-8 asynchronous counter, counting in
up-sequence. Delay of each FF is td. Initially it is at
(011)2 and 1-clock is applied then decoding errors
that will appear → 
(a)
(010)2 & (000)2
(b)
(000)2 & (101)2
(c)
(101)2 & (010)2
(d)
(010)2 & (110)2
[NAT]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-11 (Sequential Circuits (Part - 4)).
